rationale: Rear-end collision resulting in totaled vehicle and policyholder injury; clear motor-vehicle damage incident covered by auto policy.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15am yesterday while stopped at a red light. The at-fault driver struck at approximately 35 mph with no braking, totaling the vehicle (trunk crushed into back seat). Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance info is on the police report.

rationale: Tree fell on policyholder's parked vehicle, damaging the hood and windshield; this is comprehensive auto coverage (falling object damage), not property damage to the home.
claim_summary: Riley Kim's maple tree fell on their parked vehicle during windstorm; hood and windshield smashed. Comprehensive auto claim. Medium severity; awaiting damage estimate. Policy limit $400k, $1,000 deductible.
